data.description:
Context (2026-09-13 load diagnosis, C11-224/225): c11's ghostty submodule is Stage-11-Agentics/ghostty, forked from manaflow-ai/ghostty (cmux). Our base is a 2026-02-17 ghostty-org snapshot (a3aa9fa13, v1.2.0 era) with 26 commits on top; cmux's main sits on a 2026-07-22 base (ab0b9da9e) with 623 commits on top; ghostty-org main is 3,256 commits ahead of us. Nine documented fork patches (docs/ghostty-fork.md): 1-7 are cmux's, 8 (PageList SIGSEGV race) and 9 (C11-212 free-text ABI) are ours, 10 (C11-225 skip updateFrame when occluded) is a backport of upstream 14d9e600a. c11 calls 63 libghostty C functions, two of which exist only in the cmux fork (ghostty_surface_clear_selection, ghostty_surface_select_cursor_cell), so vanilla ghostty is not an option; the question is which fork base we ride.

Goal: move Stage-11-Agentics/ghostty main onto manaflow/main (cmux's current base, which already contains 14d9e600a and the two-parameter ghostty_surface_free_text), re-apply only what is still missing, and drop patches 9 and 10 (present upstream). Check whether patch 8 is still needed (grep the PageList/SlidingWindow.Meta rows snapshot; upstream may have fixed the race differently) and whether cmux's newer renderer Thread.zig (renderer_realized / skipped_invisible tiers) changes any c11 occlusion assumptions in Sources/Panels/TerminalPanel.swift and GhosttyTerminalView.swift.

Steps: (1) in the submodule, fetch origin (manaflow) and stage11; branch from origin/main; cherry-pick patch 8 if still needed; run zig fmt/ast-check; push to stage11 main only after the c11 side builds. (2) In c11, bump the pointer, rewrite docs/ghostty-fork.md so the patch list reflects the new base (delete sections 9 and 10, update the rebase-notes bullets), let build-ghosttykit pin the checksum (two-run pattern), fix any ghostty.h drift in the 63 call sites. (3) Validate on a tagged build: typing latency (Pitfalls list in CLAUDE.md), read-screen leak check (heap non-object block count stable across 50 reads), occluded renderer check from C11-225's validation (20 samples visible vs 0 hidden), copy mode, OSC 99 notifications, theme picker hooks, zsh prompt markers. (4) Release as a minor version, not a patch.

Do this after v0.66.1 ships (C11-224 + C11-225). Rebasing directly onto ghostty-org tip (option C) is explicitly out of scope: it would make us the maintainer of cmux's seven patches.
data.title: Rebase the ghostty fork onto cmux's July-2026 base (manaflow/main); retire fork patches upstream already has
